summary: Postinstall and import-time beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: @webapp-shared/login-vmok ships a `postinstall` hook (`node beacon.cjs`) and a top-level `require()` side effect in `index.js` that both invoke `beacon.cjs`. On install and on import, the beacon collects the installer's hostname (`os.hostname()`), install path (`__dirname`), current working directory (`process.cwd()`), and Node version (`process.version`) and POSTs them as JSON over plain HTTP to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint at `http://13.140.137.222:8787/_ah/dc`. The destination is not a documented publisher endpoint and the package itself is a hollow stub whose `index.js` exports a no-op `Proxy` and is described only as a 'Compatibility shim'. The scoped name `@webapp-shared/login-vmok` combined with the hollow body and the install/import beacon is consistent with a dependency-confusion probe that reports successful installation inside internal build environments to an attacker-controlled collector.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
